abstract: One-hundred fourteen patients with advanced testicular cancer were randomized to treatment consisting of either high-dose (120 mg/m2, monthly) or low-dose (15 mg/m2, daily X 5 monthly) cisplatin, both combined with vinblastine and bleomycin. There were 60 (53%) complete remissions and 42 partial remissions for an overall response rate of 90%. An additional 11 patients, 4 with carcinoma and 7 with mature teratoma, following surgical cytoreduction, were rendered free of disease. There was a significantly higher complete response rate for high dose induction chemotherapy, 63%, when compared with low dose, 43% (P = 0.03). A survival advantage was also observed for patients receiving high-dose therapy (P = 0.009). For the subgroup of patients with maximal disease and embryonal +/- teratoma +/- seminoma histology there was a clear advantage in favor of high-dose over low-dose therapy both in complete response rate and survival (P = 0.03). There have been only four relapses, all occurring within 1 year of study entry. While there has been a higher frequency of leukopenia, renal, neuromuscular, and mucosal toxicity with high-dose therapy, thus far no irreversible toxicity leading to functional impairment has been seen. The authors have demonstrated a clear-cut relationship for dose of therapy, not only with response and survival, but with the increased potential for cure as well.
abstract_ja: 進行精巣がん患者114例を、高用量(120 mg/m²、月1回)または低用量(15 mg/m²、毎日5日間、月1回)のシスプラチンに、ビンブラスチンとブレオマイシンを併用する群にランダム化した。完全寛解は60例(53%)、部分寛解は42例で、全体の奏効率は90%であった。さらに、外科的減量術後に癌腫4例、成熟奇形腫7例を含む11例が無病となった。高用量化学療法では完全奏効率が低用量の43%に対し63%と有意に高かった(P=0.03)。高用量群では生存利益も認められた(P=0.009)。最大病変および胎児性癌±奇形腫±セミノーマの組織型を持つ患者群では、高用量療法は完全奏効率と生存率の両方で低用量療法より明らかに優れていた(P=0.03)。再発は4例のみで、いずれも試験登録後1年以内に発生した。高用量療法では白血球減少、腎毒性、神経筋毒性、粘膜毒性の頻度が高かったが、機能障害を伴う不可逆的な毒性は現時点でみられていない。用量と奏効、生存率、さらには治癒可能性との間に明確な関係があることが示された。
